map.氧脉搏 = 摄氧量 ÷ 心率，代表每次心搏的摄氧量；结合动静脉氧差可估算每搏输出: Oxygen pulse = oxygen uptake ÷ heart rate, the oxygen taken up per heartbeat; combined with the arteriovenous oxygen difference it estimates stroke volume (SV), used to assess cardiopulmonary function and heart-pump efficiency, with O₂ pulse rising after endurance training.
map.💡 氧脉搏(O2 pulse)= VO2 ÷ HR，单位 ml/beat，是每搏: 💡 Oxygen pulse (O2 pulse) = VO2 ÷ HR, in ml/beat, is the product of stroke volume (SV) and the arteriovenous oxygen difference (a-vO2diff). At peak exercise a-vO2diff ≈ 15 vol%, so SV ≈ O2 pulse ÷ 0.15. The higher the O2 pulse, the better the heart's pumping efficiency.
map.VO2 单位为 ml/min（如 3200 表示 3.2 L/min）: VO2 is in ml/min (e.g. 3200 means 3.2 L/min)

map.VO2/HR 评每搏氧效。: Using VO2/HR to measure per-beat oxygen efficiency.
